values.value: Finds: Multiple blng__BillingRule__c records sharing the same Name value. Why it matters: Admins picking a billing rule from a lookup see ambiguous duplicates and frequently assign the wrong one. The mistake doesn't surface until invoices generate against a different schedule than expected. Suppress a finding: when duplicates are intentional copies for different legal entities or currencies and the team has a naming convention to disambiguate at runtime. Disable the detector: only if your org uses unique short codes elsewhere and naming collisions are acceptable. Most orgs should leave this on.
